statement: Flip classes (gates that change value at two atoms, up to complement) number at least base on 19 of 19 witness files; no counterexample in a 240 s hunt.
The one-point step holds at every cube on 12 of 12 irreducible circuits whose NOT gate is read.
MinCE S gates out -> 0 <= Phi gates S 0: no proof, no counterexample.
MISSING ARROW: in a minimal counterexample, at every mixed state (Q, R) of negative mixed slack some 0-step or 1-step has slack no larger; with it the checked chain gives 0 ≤ Phi gates S 0.

MixedStep (some paying 0-step or 1-step has slack no larger) holds at 72,106,627 of 72,106,627 mixed states with positive base: all 3^n states of 23 witness circuits (incl. six twin trees n = 14, MATCH-C(7), MATCH-S(7) n = 16), 3,166 corpus circuits, 4,010 Fano corpus circuits.

Level means of the slack nonincreasing (m_0 ≥ m_1 ≥ …, hence Phi' ≤ 0) is FALSE on 8 of 23 witness circuits: m_0 = 6 < m_1 = 8.29 on the six twin trees, 15 < 16.75 on MATCH-C(7) and MATCH-S(7); it holds on the 15 circuits with n ≤ 9.

A monotone path of the multilinear extension of the slack from the corner 0 does not exist on the twin trees and matched twin trees: every one-point slack change at ∅ is positive (8 of 176,994 cubes with positive base have every paying direction strictly uphill).

Tight-cube rigidity (slack(Q) = 0 ⇒ slack(Q+v) = 0) fails at 245 of 2,456,029 tight cubes of the Fano corpus (19-gate circuit, Q = ∅, v = 4, slack 0 → 1); it holds at 17,562 of 17,562 tight cubes of the 3,155-circuit corpus.

LP: no local potential ψ = Σ c(k, k_bottom, b) over OR gates − Σ a(|S|, |S∩Q|) with ψ ≤ slack and either ψ(Q+v) ≤ ψ(Q) for all v or up-Laplacian ≤ 0 exists on 7,199 circuits (53 parameters; 58,913 and 46,401 inequalities, both infeasible); the first form is infeasible on the twin trees alone.
Phi convex is false (Phi'' changes sign on 19 of 23 witness circuits) and negative dividend sums (power-basis coefficients of Phi ≤ 0 for k ≥ 1) hold on 2 of 23 only.
On the any-gate witness family with 4 NOT gates (general_count_below_base_t4) Phi < 0 on [0,1), 69 mixed states are negative and the mixed step fails at 40 of 529 states with positive base.
